in_marathi.name: Kousik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Auspiciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kousik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit term ‘Kausika’, meaning ‘pertaining to the sacred fire’. In Hindu mythology, Kousik refers to Lord Vishnu and is an auspicious name for a boy.

in_bengali.name: Kousik
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Auspiciousness
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kousik একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit term ‘Kausika’, meaning ‘pertaining to the sacred fire’. In Hindu mythology, Kousik refers to Lord Vishnu and is an auspicious name for a boy.
